subject: Re: Mechanic kickoff — rollout decision
body:
Team,

Platform review outcome, so we're all working from the same page:

1) Approved: Mechanic ships default-on for workloads with batch size >= 128, opt-in below that, exactly per Rafael's recommendation. The startup assertion on base LR = 1.0 is a launch blocker — Wanjiru's check goes in before the flag flips.
2) The small-batch oscillation gets a Q3 research follow-up under Efe; we're not holding rollout for it.
3) May is execution month: Paloma runs the integration through the platform release train at her committed 60%+ allocation, with Wanjiru backing her up. Santiago, please keep her calendar defended — the ranking-team result means everyone suddenly wants a piece of this.

I'll present the sweep-compute savings estimate (~2,100 GPU-hours/quarter) at the portfolio review.

Great half, team.

Ximena
